scope: Thirteen main references and two screened candidates.
Primary-source metadata and selected method reading; per-entry fresh reading and prior audit reuse are explicit.
No independent human review, systematic review, peer-method reproduction or cross-paper numerical ranking.

failed_access_notes: Some OpenReview requests returned challenge pages; official proceeding PDFs or author preprints supplied the readable method text.
OEC official PMLR PDF link served application/octet-stream; the same official linked file was downloaded and extracted locally.
source_policy.full_text_cache_publication: Downloaded papers remain under ignored cache; only bibliographic metadata and short original summaries accompany the manuscript.

project_positioning.task: Reference-program-guided recovery supervision for read-only deterministic executable KBQA with append-only handles.
specific_method_focus: mapping reference dependencies to actual execution handles
claims_not_made: CPU construction success is learned-policy recovery success
first reference divergence is necessarily first semantic error

main_references.title: {KQA Pro}: A Dataset with Explicit Compositional Programs for Complex Question Answering over Knowledge Base
supported_method_claims: KQA Pro supplies compositional executable program annotations.

reading_scope: Paper task description and KoPL function appendix, PDF page 15

main_references.title: {Qwen2.5} Technical Report
fresh_reading_scope: Author report version 1 metadata and abstract
supported_method_claims: Qwen2.5 is the model family used in the project.

reading_scope: Section 2 architecture/model-size table and post-training overview
scope_notes: Corporate author Qwen Team follows the report byline.
No general 128K-context claim is applied to the 3B model.

main_references.title: {LoRA}: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
main_references.publication_status: ICLR 2022; author preprint initially released in 2021
fresh_reading_scope: Author preprint metadata and abstract; author repository README; indexed official OpenReview PDF first-page publication label
supported_method_claims: LoRA freezes base weights and trains low-rank update matrices.
scope_notes: OpenReview full-page access was challenged. ICLR 2022 publication label was available in the indexed official PDF; method evidence comes from the author preprint and repository, not a claimed successful full OpenReview read.

reading_scope: Section 4 low-rank update and scaling formulation
scope_notes: OpenReview full page was challenged during this audit; method details were read from the author preprint, not claimed as a successful full OpenReview-page read.
ICLR 2022 venue is recorded separately from the 2021 preprint year.

main_references.title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
fresh_reading_scope: Official metadata; paper section 3 and data-aggregation procedure
supported_method_claims: DAgger collects expert labels at learner-visited states and iteratively aggregates training data.
scope_notes: No DAgger regret bound is claimed for the project fixed-rollout construction.
Author name Drew Bagnell follows the official PMLR citation metadata.
No DAgger theoretical guarantee is transferred to the local fixed-rollout suffix-replay scheme.

main_references.title: {ReAct}: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
main_references.publication_status: ICLR 2023; arXiv version 3 identifies camera-ready version
fresh_reading_scope: Author preprint version 3 metadata and abstract
supported_method_claims: ReAct interleaves reasoning, actions and observations.
scope_notes: The original paper also discusses fine-tuning; it is not categorized as prompting-only.

reading_scope: ICLR 2023 conference-version metadata, abstract and introduction
scope_notes: ReAct is not described as exclusively a prompting method.

main_references.title: {Reflexion}: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
supported_method_claims: Verbal reflection and episodic memory guide later attempts without core-policy weight updates.

scope_notes: No claim of a full-paper replication or complete experiment audit.

main_references.title: {Self-Refine}: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
supported_method_claims: The same model generates an answer, feedback and a revision without additional parameter training in the core scheme.

scope_notes: No claim of a full-paper replication or complete experiment audit.

main_references.title: Agent-R: Training Language Model Agents to Reflect via Iterative Self-Training
main_references.publication_status: arXiv preprint version 3; formal venue not confirmed
supported_method_claims: MCTS supplies successful and unsuccessful branches; selected transition positions and revision text form training trajectories.
The method iterates trajectory collection and self-training.
scope_notes: Do not claim failure/success trajectory stitching itself as new in the present paper.

main_references.title: Training LLM-Based Agents with Synthetic Self-Reflected Trajectories and Partial Masking
main_references.publication_status: arXiv preprint version 1; formal venue not confirmed
supported_method_claims: A teacher reviews student actions and supplies reflections and corrected actions; successful corrected trajectories are retained.
Erroneous thought/action tokens are masked during training.
scope_notes: No environment rollback claim is inferred from teacher correction.
Partial masking is established prior work.

main_references.title: Imitation Learning for Multi-turn LM Agents via On-policy Expert Corrections
fresh_reading_scope: Official PMLR metadata; final PDF first page and sections 3.1–3.3; preprint method cross-check
supported_method_claims: A student rollout switches to a stronger expert at a sampled intermediate point; successful trajectories are retained using environment verification.
Loss is applied to expert tokens, while student and environment tokens are masked.
scope_notes: The citekey retains 2025 for compatibility; bibliography metadata uses the official 2026 publication.
Claims follow the final paper rather than an aggregator conference label.
The method does not inherit DAgger no-regret guarantees merely by inspiration.

main_references.title: Training Language Models to Self-Correct via Reinforcement Learning
fresh_reading_scope: Official PDF publication header and author list; sections 5.1–5.3; preprint method cross-check
supported_method_claims: Two-stage online RL first trains a second attempt under a constrained first-attempt distribution, then jointly optimizes attempts with correction-progress reward shaping.
scope_notes: The final paper uses RLOO; do not conflate final implementation details with an earlier preprint.
Its math/code response correction setting differs from explicit executable-handle remapping.

main_references.title: Robust Tool Use via Fission-GRPO: Learning to Recover from Execution Errors
fresh_reading_scope: Official ACL metadata and PDF author list; section 3, especially 3.3.2–3.3.3
supported_method_claims: Failed tool executions create on-policy recovery groups with diagnostic feedback and corrective GRPO updates.
Semantic feedback is supplied by a fine-tuned Error Simulator; its construction uses training annotations.
scope_notes: Do not characterize simulator-based supervision as annotation-free.
No project GRPO result is included in this short paper.

main_references.title: ReTerm: Recovery Training for Self-Improving Terminal Agents
main_references.publication_status: arXiv preprint version 2 dated 2026-10-14; formal venue not confirmed
supported_method_claims: Failed terminal interaction histories and environment snapshots are restored for stronger-teacher recovery continuations.
Selected recovery continuations are trained with teacher-only token loss; an additional online recovery-branch GRPO method is provided.
scope_notes: Real failed history plus suffix supervision is established prior art.
The project distinction is given-program handle mapping and deterministic replay in a read-only setting, not general terminal recovery.

screened_candidates.title: PALADIN
screened_candidates.status: preprint; conference status not independently confirmed from an official accepted-paper record
screened_candidates.method_summary: Injected tool-failure training with expert recovery annotations and inference-time exemplar retrieval.
screened_candidates.comparison_implication: Related recovery supervision; differs from naturally sampled reference divergence and existing program targets.
scope_notes: No performance numbers were reused. A conference copyright footer alone was not treated as acceptance proof.

screened_candidates.title: Executable Prefix Values for Locating Agent Failures
screened_candidates.status: preprint dated 2026-10-13; formal venue not confirmed
screened_candidates.method_summary: Reconstructs executable histories and resamples frozen-agent continuations to estimate success probability under remaining budget.
screened_candidates.comparison_implication: Diagnostic rather than recovery-target SFT; distinguishes textual discrepancy from causal failure or recoverability.
scope_notes: Supports retaining the operational term first reference divergence in the project.
